title: Traceable claims can still remain unfit for a conclusion
unit_of_analysis: declared v0.5 claim and audit gate
sample: 14 material claims, five evidence gates, and one conclusion-eligibility state
transformation: Read the five categorical gate states and conclusion-eligibility result for each mapped claim, preserve the states without assigning a numeric score, and render letter labels with color.
claim_supported: Traceability alone does not make a claim eligible for a conclusion. Evidence fitness and dependency closure block the stronger Oko and dependent paper claims in this release.
prohibited_interpretation: The matrix supplies no aggregate trust score, source-truth determination, independent reliability estimate, or ranking of claims.
